title: In praise of small, understandable tools
excerpt: A note about software that can be held in one person’s head—and why constraint can be a form of care.

sections.label: Observation
sections.title: Complexity has a maintenance cost.
paragraphs: Every dependency makes a promise about the future. Sometimes that trade is worthwhile. Often a plain file, a short script, or a static page will live longer and ask less of everyone who inherits it.

sections.label: Practice
sections.title: Choose the smallest durable thing.
points: Prefer formats people can open without special tools
Leave room for the next maintainer to understand the whole
